headline: Neuralink Secures FDA Approval for First US Pivotal Brain-Chip Trial
summary: Neuralink has received FDA approval to conduct its first pivotal US clinical trial for its brain-computer interface technology.
why: Regulatory approvals for novel medical devices mark critical milestones for development-stage medical technology companies seeking commercial viability.

impacts.name: Neuralink
impacts.why: FDA clearance enables the company to advance clinical trials.
